segments.text: Ninety percent survive. Ten percent die. Same exact fact, and you'll choose differently depending on which one you hear.
It's called framing. The words wrapped around a number change the decision, even when the odds are identical.
It's why ninety-five percent fat free sells, and five percent fat doesn't. Same yogurt. Different feeling.
Once you see it, you can't unsee it. In ads, on menus, in every deal you're offered.
Watch how they frame it. Honest verdict on the channel.
